visual_brief.subject: A described vocal character shaped into a reusable project-scoped voice artifact
verified_context: OpenAI now lets API customers describe vocal qualities in text, create and save a resulting voice, and select it when a GPT-Live session starts.
Prompt-generated voices work with GPT-Live and are not supported by the Text to Speech, Realtime, or audio Chat Completions APIs.
The voice is project-scoped and changing it requires a new session.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Voice design becomes a governed reusable application artifact rather than an ephemeral catalog choice.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A quiet sculptural waveform is shaped through an adjustable terracotta aperture and settles into a distinct reusable physical form on a stone plinth.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. The transient ribbons, precise aperture, and resolved object form a complete input-to-artifact metaphor with excellent small-size legibility.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. The adjustable iris feels governed and crafted, though the relationship between the incoming sound and stored object is slightly less direct.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. The tuning instrument and shell are elegant, but the apparatus reads more like sound reproduction than creation of a persisted voice resource.

crop_review.article_desktop: The wide crop preserves the incoming ribbons, aperture, and completed artifact.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop retains the aperture and enough of both transient input and stable output to preserve the idea.
crop_review.thumbnail: The terracotta opening and striped artifact remain distinct at 320px wide.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected image shares the references' crafted tooling, stone-and-paper materiality, fine line rhythm, sparse palette, and clear spatial progression while avoiding UI or diagram language.
